description: Price a private transfer (car/van with driver) from one place in Sri Lanka to another. Pass the pickup and drop-off exactly as the traveller named them - a town ("Kandy"), an airport ("Colombo airport", "Bandaranaike") or a station. For a hotel, pass the TOWN it is in. Returns the resolved route and fares per vehicle that fits the party. If a place is ambiguous or unknown, it returns status "unresolved" with candidates - ask the traveller, do not guess. Use this for any transfer price, never a transfer page found by search_tours.

from.description: Pickup: town, airport or station, e.g. "Colombo airport".

to.description: Drop-off: town, airport or station, e.g. "Kandy".

name: quote_transfer
